details.description: DALL-E 3 is OpenAI's third-generation text-to-image model, released via ChatGPT and the API in fall 2023. It uses GPT-4 to automatically rewrite prompts before generating an image, and produces a single image per request at 1024x1024, 1792x1024, or 1024x1792 resolution, with a Standard or HD quality setting and Natural or Vivid style options. OpenAI's own deprecations page set a shutdown date of May 12, 2026 for DALL-E 3, and Microsoft separately scheduled the Azure OpenAI version for retirement on February 18, 2026 (with a possible six-month extension for pre-existing deployments) -- both dates have already passed as of this research date, and neither OpenAI's nor Azure's current model documentation lists it as available any longer.
advantages: Automatically rewrites prompts with GPT-4 before generating an image, which OpenAI says improves prompt fidelity.
Generates images at three fixed resolutions -- 1024x1024, 1792x1024, and 1024x1792 -- about 75% higher than DALL-E 2's maximum resolution.
Offers an HD quality setting OpenAI says produces finer details and greater consistency, plus Natural and Vivid style options.
disadvantages: Deprecated and removed from OpenAI's API on May 12, 2026, per OpenAI's deprecations page; OpenAI's current model documentation recommends GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst as the replacement.
On Azure, DALL-E 3 was scheduled for retirement on February 18, 2026, with Microsoft recommending GPT Image models such as gpt-image-1-mini as the replacement.
Only supports generating one image per request (n=1), and only the image-generation endpoint -- the Edits and Variations endpoints work with DALL-E 2, not DALL-E 3.
OpenAI's own cookbook notes it struggles with custom fonts, letter design, and seamless texture generation.
use_cases: Generating original images from natural-language text prompts
Producing images in square, portrait, or landscape aspect ratios for illustration or marketing use
HD-quality image generation where finer detail is needed

notes: Catalog's deprecation_date for this target is empty. OpenAI's own deprecations page gives an explicit shutdown date of 2026-05-12 for dall-e-3 (announced 2025-11-14, recommending gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1, or gpt-image-1-mini), and OpenAI's current model documentation separately names GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst -- a newer model -- as today's recommended replacement. Microsoft's Azure documentation set a DALL-E 3 retirement date of 2026-02-18 (with a possible 6-month extension for pre-existing deployments). All of these dates are already past as of this research date, and Azure's current model-catalog/retirement-schedule pages no longer list dall-e-3 at all. All target URIs are azure/hd and azure/standard quality variants, so this describes the underlying model, not any one variant.
